title: Cassiopeia A in 3D: ASCII VTK files created from telescope data

links.label: Zip of ASCII VTK files, 3.94 MB

evidence.locator: Cassiopeia A: "ASCII VTK files created from telescope data" (3.94 MB). The zip's README: created by NASA, the Smithsonian Astrophysical Observatory's Chandra X-ray Center, MIT and T. DeLaney et al., from Chandra, Spitzer, the NOAO 4-meter at Kitt Peak and the Michigan-Dartmouth-MIT 2.4-meter. Seven surfaces: newar ([Ar II], 34,725 vertices), newsi, fekcorr, newhetg, newopt, newjets, cco.
